segments.segment_summary: A man in a pink shirt performs various maintenance tasks on an old green Oliver Super 55 tractor inside a barn or garage.

key_moments.caption: The man uses a socket wrench to work on the tractor's battery terminal.
The man reaches into the engine compartment to adjust some wiring.
The man kneels down and appears to inflate the large rear tire of the tractor.
A close-up shows the man using a socket wrench on a bolt on the side of the tractor.

segments.segment_summary: The man climbs onto the tractor, starts the engine, and drives it out of the barn into a sandy area.

key_moments.caption: The man climbs up onto the tractor seat.
The tractor's engine turns over and starts.
The man drives the tractor out from under the barn's cover.

segments.segment_summary: The man drives the green tractor up the ramps onto a flatbed trailer and then begins to secure it with chains.

key_moments.caption: The man carefully drives the tractor up the ramps and onto the wooden deck of the trailer.
After parking the tractor, the man gets off and folds up the trailer ramps.
The man uses a chain and a red binder to secure the front of the tractor to the trailer.
